label: Courier at the door
voice_source: Real human voice · one speaker · laptop mic
description: A delivery call with a rider's name, a Hyderabad area, a PIN code and a callback number.
watch_for: Delivery stays an ordinary word, while the rider's name, the area and the PIN come out right.
tip: Say the numbers digit by digit, at your normal phone speed.
spoken: नमस्ते, आपकी डिलीवरी के लिए वेंकटेश्वर राव कोंडापुर पहुँच गए हैं। पिन कोड पाँच शून्य शून्य शून्य आठ चार है, और उनका नंबर नौ आठ शून्य शून्य पाँच एक दो तीन चार छह है।
reference: नमस्ते, आपकी डिलीवरी के लिए Venkateswara Rao Kondapur पहुँच गए हैं। पिन कोड 500084 है, और उनका नंबर 9800512346 है।

sms.body: Your parcel is out for delivery to Kondapur 500084.
Your parcel is out for delivery to Kothapet 500035.

label: Bank EMI reminder
voice_source: Real human voice · one speaker · laptop mic
description: A bank reminder with a rupee amount that is easy to mishear, plus a caller's name.
watch_for: Chaudah hazaar must stay ₹14,500. Pehchaan never changes money on its own.
tip: Speak it like a normal Hinglish phone call.
spoken: Hello sir, HDFC Bank se Lakshmi Narayanan baat kar rahe hain. Aapki EMI chaudah hazaar paanch sau rupaye pending hai, please kal tak bhar dijiye.
reference: Hello sir, HDFC Bank se Lakshmi Narayanan baat kar rahe hain. Aapki EMI 14500 rupaye pending hai, please kal tak bhar dijiye.

sms.body: Dear Customer, your EMI of Rs 14,500 is due tomorrow.
Dear Customer, your EMI of Rs 40,500 is due tomorrow.

label: Food order directions
voice_source: Real human voice · one speaker · laptop mic
description: Directions with a local area, a brand and a PIN code, spoken quickly.
watch_for: Gachibowli and Swiggy are matched by sound, and the six-digit PIN is checked.
tip: Say it a little fast, like giving directions to a rider.
spoken: Bhaiya Swiggy ka order Gachibowli mein DLF ke gate par le aana, pin code paanch zero zero zero three do hai.
reference: Bhaiya Swiggy ka order Gachibowli mein DLF ke gate par le aana, pin code 500032 hai.

sms.body: Your Swiggy order is on the way to Gachibowli.
Your Swiggy order is on the way to Gandipet.

label: Refund in lakhs
voice_source: Real human voice · one speaker · laptop mic
description: Indian-English money in lakhs and thousands, with a person, a bank and a callback.
watch_for: Two lakh forty thousand becomes ₹2,40,000, and the phone number stays exactly as heard.
spoken: Hi, this is Priya Raghunathan from Kotak Mahindra Bank. Your refund of two lakh forty thousand rupees is approved. Please call me back on nine one two three four zero five six seven eight.
reference: Hi, this is Priya Raghunathan from Kotak Mahindra Bank. Your refund of 240000 rupees is approved. Please call me back on 9123405678.

sms.body: Your refund of Rs 2,40,000 has been approved.
Your refund of Rs 2,14,000 has been approved.

label: Flat rent and area
voice_source: Real human voice · one speaker · laptop mic
description: A rental call with a spoken Hindi amount and a neighbourhood that sounds like others.
watch_for: Dedh lakh is read as ₹1,50,000, and Banjara Hills is not swapped for a similar place.
tip: Speak calmly, as if talking to a broker.
spoken: बंजारा हिल्स वाले फ्लैट का डिपॉज़िट डेढ़ लाख रुपये है और किराया पैंतीस हज़ार रुपये महीना है।
reference: Banjara Hills वाले फ्लैट का डिपॉज़िट 150000 रुपये है और किराया 35000 रुपये महीना है।

label: Wrong-context trap
voice_source: Real human voice · one speaker · laptop mic
description: The phone's hints are deliberately wrong. A naive fixer copies them. Pehchaan should not.
watch_for: The misleading contact and amount must not overwrite what was really said.
tip: Say it naturally. The trap is in the hints, not your voice.
spoken: Main Rohit Kulkarni bol raha hoon Zerodha se, aapka payout bees hazaar rupaye Madhapur branch se aayega.
reference: Main Rohit Kulkarni bol raha hoon Zerodha se, aapka payout 20000 rupaye Madhapur branch se aayega.
